buildCommand: node scripts/check-env.mjs && prisma generate && next build

crons.comment: G10 — safety-net drain of the AiJob queue once per day. The PRIMARY drain path is the frontend kick-off (every 'Run in background' click immediately POSTs /api/ai-jobs/run-next as a fire-and-forget). This daily cron is only here to catch orphaned jobs — e.g. a user closed the tab before the kick fired, or the worker crashed mid-job and the job sat in QUEUED. Each tick claims ONE job and exits (60s budget never exceeded). Vercel Hobby plans are limited to ONE cron invocation per day; to get sub-hourly draining either (a) upgrade to Pro and change schedule back to '*/5 * * * *', or (b) point an external cron (cron-job.org, GitHub Actions schedule, etc.) at /api/ai-jobs/run-next with the X-Worker-Secret header.
